Athena: # Athena Spark: the workgroup sets the engine version; runtime_version records it
--platform-option s3_staging_dir=s3://my-bucket/staging/  # External tables over staged Parquet
Azure Synapse: # Dedicated SQL pool with specific resource class
BigQuery: # Project and credentials come from: benchbox setup --platform bigquery
--platform-option staging_root=gs://bucket/benchbox/  # External table over GCS Parquet
Compression (Advanced): benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --compression zstd:9  # Max compression
benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --compression none  # Disable
Data Generation Only: benchbox run --benchmark tpch --scale 100 --phases generate  # Generate data only
Data Regeneration: benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --force  # Regenerate all
benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --force datagen  # Data only
DataFrame Platforms: benchbox run --platform polars --benchmark tpch --mode dataframe  # Fastest DataFrame
benchbox run --platform dask --benchmark tpch --mode dataframe --scale 1  # Distributed
benchbox run --platform cudf --benchmark tpch --mode dataframe  # GPU-accelerated
Driver & Version Management: # BenchBox uses whatever driver version is installed in the current environment.
# When invoked via 'uv run', uv syncs your env to uv.lock first - a version you
# installed manually (e.g. uv pip install duckdb==1.5.0) may be silently reverted.
# Use driver_auto_install to reliably switch versions without touching the lock file:
# Or override inline without modifying the lock file:
uv run --with "duckdb==1.5.0" benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch
# Pin driver for any platform (not just DuckDB):
# Verify which version actually ran: check result JSON field execution.driver_version_actual
# or watch the 'Running ... [driver X.Y.Z]' line in CLI output.
Dry Run (Preview): benchbox run --dry-run ./preview --benchmark tpch --phases generate  # Data-only preview
Export and Analysis: benchbox export --last --format csv --format html  # Export most recent run
# Results can be loaded: python -c "import json; data = json.load(open('result.json'))"
Local Platforms: benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch  # Fastest local option
benchbox run --platform sqlite --benchmark ssb --scale 1  # Baseline comparison
benchbox run --platform postgresql --benchmark tpch  # Requires local PostgreSQL
Platform Comparison: # Run same benchmark on multiple platforms for comparison
PostgreSQL: benchbox run --platform postgresql --benchmark tpch  # localhost:5432 default
Presto: # Host, port and username come from the presto entry in ~/.benchbox/credentials.yaml
Query Selection: benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --queries Q22  # Single query
Snowflake: --platform-option staging_root=s3://bucket/benchbox/  # External tables over staged Parquet
Trino: # Host, port and username come from the trino entry in ~/.benchbox/credentials.yaml
Tuning Configuration: benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --tuning tuned  # Auto-discovers template
benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --tuning notuning  # Baseline, no tuning
benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --tuning auto  # Smart system defaults
#   'auto'     - Uses smart defaults based on system profile
Tuning Discovery: benchbox tuning list  # List all available tuning templates
benchbox tuning list --platform duckdb  # Templates for specific platform
benchbox tuning show tuned --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch  # Preview resolution
benchbox tuning show ./my-tuning.yaml  # Preview custom config
Validation (Advanced): benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --validation loose  # ±5% tolerance
benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --validation full  # All checks
